description: A single-panel figure that is a rendered data table, "Table A2 Constitutive relationship parameters of steels"; there are no micrographs, spectra or curves. Rows are grouped by three steel conditions — AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T — each subdivided into five constituent phases j labelled F, B/TM, FM, RA and DIM. Columns are: K_j (MPa·μm^1/2), α_j, M_j, G_j (GPa), b_j (nm), k_j^1, k_j^2, ρ_0 (10^14 m^-2), R (μm) and Δh (μm). K_j = 600 MPa·μm^1/2 is printed only on the F rows and K_j = 149 MPa·μm^1/2 only on the RA rows; all other K_j cells are blank. α_j = 0.38 for F, B/TM, FM and DIM and 0.35 for RA. G_j = 66.0 GPa for F, 81.6 GPa for B/TM, FM and DIM, 72.0 GPa for RA. b_j = 0.248 nm everywhere except RA (0.250 nm); k_j^1 = 0.015 throughout; k_j^2 = 20 except RA = 10. ρ_0 varies phase-by-phase within each sample. R and Δh are listed per sample on the F row only: 1.58/3.40, 2.13/3.48 and 1.44/4.33 μm. The table supplies the phase-resolved constitutive inputs used to model the three annealed low-density steels.

observations.observation: The figure is a single rendered data table titled 'Table A2 Constitutive relationship parameters of steels' with no graphical or micrograph panel.
The table is organised into three sample groups, AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T, each spanning five rows labelled by j = F, B/TM, FM, RA and DIM.
K_j (MPa·μm^1/2) is populated only for F (600) and RA (149) in every sample group; the B/TM, FM and DIM cells of that column are blank.
α_j is 0.38 for F, B/TM, FM and DIM in all three samples, and 0.35 for RA in all three samples.
G_j (GPa) is 66.0 for F, 81.6 for B/TM, FM and DIM, and 72.0 for RA across all three sample groups.
b_j (nm) is 0.248 for every phase except RA, which is 0.250 in all three samples.
k_j^1 = 0.015 for every row, while k_j^2 = 20 for F, B/TM, FM and DIM but 10 for RA.
ρ_0 (10^14 m^-2) for AN750-T: F 0.33, B/TM 0.44, FM 0.86, RA 0.81, DIM blank; for AN800-T: F 0.46, B/TM 0.99, FM 1.04, RA 1.01, DIM blank; for AN850-T: F 0.37, B/TM 1.04, FM 1.16, RA 0.68, DIM blank.
R (μm) is printed only on the F row of each group: 1.58 for AN750-T, 2.13 for AN800-T and 1.44 for AN850-T.
Δh (μm) is printed only on the F row of each group: 3.40 for AN750-T, 3.48 for AN800-T and 4.33 for AN850-T.
Within every sample, ρ_0 rises in the order F < B/TM < FM, and the FM value increases monotonically with annealing temperature from AN750-T to AN850-T (0.86 → 1.04 → 1.16 ×10^14 m^-2).
The caption states the table lists constitutive relationship parameters of steels.
